aiAgents.name: Emergency Intelligence Agent
aiAgents.role: Incident triage, report corroboration, risk trajectory & missing-data detection
aiAgents.description: Analyzes verified/unverified incident records, field reports, deterministic risk assessments, and duplicate candidates. Never verifies, rejects, or closes incidents.

aiAgents.name: Environmental & Weather Intelligence Agent
aiAgents.role: Live weather telemetry freshness, severe hazard triggers & forecast impact
aiAgents.description: Evaluates Open-Meteo weather observations, rainfall/wind/heat triggers, and weather-risk scores. Never fabricates official government disaster warnings.

aiAgents.name: Resource Intelligence Agent
aiAgents.role: Warehouse availability, stock ledger accuracy, reservations, expiry & shortages
aiAgents.description: Inspects real warehouse stock, active reservations, expiring batches, incoming shipments, and demand gaps. Never treats reserved/in-transit stock as freely available or mutates stock.

aiAgents.name: Human Impact & Priority Agent
aiAgents.role: Affected population triage, vulnerable groups, unmet needs & fairness analysis
aiAgents.description: Assesses affected households, vulnerable population counts, urgent relief requests, and competing under-served incidents. Never fabricates population counts or infers sensitive attributes.

aiAgents.name: Logistics & Route Intelligence Agent
aiAgents.role: Warehouse matching, fleet readiness, route hazards & ETA constraints
aiAgents.description: Runs after specialist context gathering to evaluate candidate warehouses, vehicles, drivers, active dispatches, and route hazards. Always states road safety/GPS availability honestly and never dispatches autonomously.

aiAgents.name: Response Planning Agent
aiAgents.role: Unified response plan synthesis, deduplicated actions & trade-off articulation
aiAgents.description: Synthesizes verified findings from specialist agents into a single human-approvable response plan with alternatives, constraints, and optional Gemini narrative synthesis. Zero autonomous execution.

aiAgents.name: Response Monitoring Agent
aiAgents.role: Continuous change detection, trigger triage & reassessment guidance
aiAgents.description: Evaluates meaningful operational deltas across active dispatches, shortages, weather shifts, and proactive triggers while preventing alert fatigue through cooldowns and deduplication.

aiAgents.name: Evidence & Safety Verification Agent
aiAgents.role: Deterministic code-level verification of facts, stock, fleet, routes, evidence & RBAC
aiAgents.description: Independently validates every proposed plan action against live database records, permissions, freshness limits, and safety invariants. Returns VALID, VALID_WITH_WARNINGS, INCOMPLETE, or REJECTED.
